tools.publication_requirement: Apply a visible SI-generated watermark before including this generated image in the submission or its public project materials.

code: Project code was developed with SI assistance; third-party source licenses remain applicable.
data: NASA and other source datasets retain their recorded provenance. Derived science products are numerical calculations from those sources; no generative fabrication of scientific values is asserted.
media: No final demonstration video, synthetic narration, or music was found in the inspected project files; final video assets require a separate check.
branding: The supplied submission rules prohibit generated content using, containing or modifying NASA branding and design elements, including logos, flags and mission identifiers.
